prompt: What is the capacity of the Olympic stadium used during the first Winter Games attended by a tropical nation? This nation was visited by the 5th Cavalry Regiment (US) in 1901.
answer: The nation was the **Philippines**, which first attended the Winter Olympics at **Sapporo 1972**. The Olympic stadium used there, **Makomanai Open Stadium**, had a capacity of **30,000 spectators**.
